idea-plugin.name: Flutter Widget Wrapper
idea-plugin.description:
Context-aware Flutter widget wrappers in the Alt+Enter menu. Wrap a widget without moving code by hand, fixing indentation or rebuilding constructors.

Wrap the right way, in the right place

  • Built-in wrappers: Align, AnimatedSize, Expanded, Flexible, GestureDetector, InkWell, Opacity, Positioned, SafeArea, SingleChildScrollView, SliverPadding, SliverToBoxAdapter and Stack.
  • 24 optional presets: Consumer, BlocBuilder, ValueListenableBuilder, AnimatedBuilder, LayoutBuilder, Hero, Visibility, ClipRRect, Tooltip, Dismissible and more.
  • Only valid wrappers are offered: Expanded and Flexible for direct children of Row, Column or Flex, Positioned for direct children of Stack, and only sliver-aware wrappers inside sliver:/slivers:.
  • Tab-stops (with choices) jump to the values to edit right after wrapping, and enclosing const keywords are removed when a wrapper adds a closure.

Many ways to wrap

  • Alt+Enter, with a preview for every wrapper, or a single searchable Wrap with… popup.
  • Surround With (Ctrl+Alt+T / ⌥⌘T) and postfix templates: Text('a').opacity + Tab.
  • Wrap several selected siblings of a children: list at once.
  • Replace Widget with… swaps a wrapper for another one while keeping its child (e.g. Flexible → Expanded).

Your own wrappers

  • Create wrapper from Widget turns an existing widget into a reusable wrapper, including builders such as BlocBuilder, Consumer or StreamBuilder: the widget their builder: returns becomes the placeholder, and early returns are kept.
  • Dart editor with live preview and validation; import and export as JSON.
  • Share wrappers with your team through a .flutter-wrappers.json file in the project root.
  • Edit or hide any wrapper right from the Alt+Enter submenu.
